definition: A function of the form $f(x) = ax^{2} + bx + c$, where $a \ne 0$, so its highest power of $x$ is $x^{2}$.
The U-shaped curve that is the graph of a quadratic function; it opens upwards when $a > 0$ and downwards when $a < 0$.
Rewriting $x^{2} + bx$ as $\left(x + \frac{b}{2}\right)^{2} - \left(\frac{b}{2}\right)^{2}$, which turns a quadratic into the vertex form $a(x - h)^{2} + k$.
